data.title: Delta flights faced brief delays at Atlanta airport over automated system issue
data.description:
Delta Air Lines experienced brief delays on flights to and from Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, the busiest in the US.

Here are some details:

  • The airline said in a statement that it was using "manual workarounds" to safely dispatch flights while efforts continued to restore automation for departing flight weight and balance calculations.

  • The company also said it was working with air traffic control counterparts to ease congestion at its Atlanta hub.

  • The US Federal Aviation Administration briefly issued a ground stop because of the issue, resulting in delays of about an hour before it was lifted. The FAA said the disruption was not related to any FAA air traffic systems.

  • Weight and balance calculations are required before takeoff to ensure an aircraft remains within safety limits and maintains a proper center of gravity for stable flight, according to the FAA.

  • The disruption comes after a US router outage triggered a nationwide ground stop on November 13 that disrupted more than 18,000 flights and affected about 1 million passengers.

data.title: Joint Proposal Selected for the Space Strategy Fund Project "Development and Demonstration of General-Purpose Ground Antennas and Use Cases to Expand the Utilization of Satellite Communications"
data.description:
TOKYO, Nov 22, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Sharp Corporation, Saitama University, ARAV Inc., Prodrone Co., Ltd., and FURUNO ELECTRIC CO., LTD., together with Institute of Science Tokyo, jointly submitted a proposal for a technology development theme under the Space Strategy Fund for which the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) invited proposals. The proposal involves the development of general-purpose ground antennas compatible with 5G NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) as next-generation satellite communication terminals and the demonstration of their use in the mobility sector under "Development and Demonstration of General-Purpose Ground Antennas and Use Cases to Expand the Utilization of Satellite Communications". The joint proposal was selected on October 30, 2026.

About the Space Strategy Fund

Amid the global expansion of the space market, the Space Strategy Fund was established at JAXA in March 2024 to provide long-term support for technology development in the space sector. The Fund supports a wide range of initiatives undertaken by private companies, universities, research institutions, and other organizations, ranging from business demonstrations to innovative technology development. It provides support over multiple years, for up to 10 years, in three areas: "Space Transportation," "Satellites," and "Space Exploration."

Development of General-Purpose Ground Antennas Supporting Multiple Satellite Communication Services

Further utilization of satellite communications is expected to help ensure stable connectivity even in areas with limited terrestrial communication network coverage, such as mountainous areas, maritime areas, and disaster-affected areas. Based on this proposal, the parties will develop a general-purpose ground antenna compatible with 5G NTN, a communications standard that applies widely adopted terrestrial 5G technology to satellite communications and is being standardized internationally. In addition, the antenna will be designed to support multiple frequency bands, with the aim of enabling a single antenna to switch between multiple satellite communication services.

Demonstration of Applications in the Mobility Sector

The general-purpose ground antennas developed under this project will be installed on vehicles, drones, construction machinery, and vessels to conduct demonstration trials of satellite communication. The trials will assess communication quality and stability while in motion and verify the potential use of satellite communications for applications such as data transmission during autonomous driving, remote inspection, and video transmission.

Source: Sharp Corporation

data.title: Compass Group plans to shift primary listing from London to New York, FT reports
data.description:
Compass Group , the world's largest caterer, plans to shift its primary listing from London to New York, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Reuters could not immediately verify the report. Compass Group did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.

Here are some details:

  • The Surrey, England headquartered company is expected to announce it is moving its listing to New York as soon as at its full-year results on Tuesday, according to FT

  • Compass, which counts Google, Amazon and Microsoft among its clients, also provides catering and support services to the defence sector, airline lounges and data centres

  • In July, Compass said it secured $4.3 billion of new business wins over the previous 12 months, up 16% year-on-year, with half coming from first-time outsourcing clients. It also saw a modest boost in North America volumes

  • The planned move would add to pressure on London's stock market, which has struggled to attract and retain listings as companies seek access to deeper US capital markets and higher valuations

data.title: MHI-MS Holds 70th Anniversary Ceremony for Its Paper Converting Machinery Business
data.description:
TOKYO, Nov 22, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Machinery Systems, Ltd. (MHI-MS), a part of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group, held an event in Tokyo on November 13 to celebrate the 70th anniversary of its Paper Converting Machinery business division. The ceremony marked 70 years since the delivery in 1956 of its first corrugating machine for making corrugated board.

MHI-MS's Paper Converting Machinery business has delivered more than 300 corrugating machines to corrugated board manufacturers in Japan and around the world. In addition, MHI-MS began manufacturing box making machines that form corrugated board into folded boxes in 1958. More than 700 machines of the best-selling EVOL series have been delivered. Recently, the space-saving MC series has also been launched, offering an ideal solution for shorter run lengths with frequent job changes. These units support the foundation of logistics.

The ceremony was attended by representatives from 60 Japanese companies, 62 customers, and MHI-MS. Satoshi Kojima, President and CEO of MHI-MS, and Kohei Kobayashi, Head of Printing & Packaging Machinery Headquarters, expressed their gratitude, and asserted that MHI-MS would continue to embrace new challenges and contribute to the further development of the corrugated board industry through paper converting machinery.

MHI-MS also presented its world-first technology for the future of the corrugated board industry, an automated control unit(1) that uses AI predictive models to prevent warping of boards during production due to moisture imbalance between the inner and outer liners. In addition, Shinjiro Hiyama, former Japanese baseball player for the Hanshin Tigers and currently a baseball commentator, presented a lecture on lessons from sport for organizational management.

Global demand for cardboard is rising as an alternative to plastic from an environmental standpoint, while at the same time corrugated board factories facing labor shortages require equipment to reduce manual operations and workloads. MHI-MS will continue to leverage the comprehensive strengths, diverse technologies, and years of accumulated experience and know-how of MHI Group to develop and market optimal solutions.

(1) For details, see the following press release:

MHI-MS Develops World's First AI-Based Corrugated Board Warp Control System

About MHI Group

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group is one of the world's leading industrial groups, spanning energy, smart infrastructure, industrial machinery, aerospace and defense. MHI Group combines cutting-edge technology with deep experience to deliver innovative, integrated solutions that help to realize a carbon neutral world, improve the quality of life and ensure a safer world. Share buyback for the employee participation programme and for long term management remuneration

The Executive Board of TAG Immobilien AG (ISIN DE0008303504) („Company“) today resolved to repurchase up to 150,000 shares of the Company (equivalent to approximately 0.08% of the Company’s share capital) which shall be used to cover obligations arising from the existing employee participation programme and for long-term compensation of the Executive Board. The share repurchase is being conducted in accordance with the provisions of Section 71(1)(2) of the German Stock Corporation Act (Aktiengesetz – AktG) and is intended solely for the purposes stated above. The maximum total volume of the share buyback (acquisition costs excluding ancillary acquisition costs) is EUR 1.9 million.

The share buyback will begin on 23 November 2026 and will be completed by 31 December 2026. It will be carried out by an independent financial service provider in accordance with the safe harbour rules defined under Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council dated 16 April 2014, as amended, in conjunction with the provisions of the Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1052 of the Commission dated 8 March 2016. In particular, the financial services provider is required to execute the repurchase of shares as follows:

1. The shares are purchased at market prices in accordance with the aforementioned regulations and the authorisation of the shareholders meeting. The shares are not purchased at a price higher than the higher of the price of the last independent trade and the highest current independent purchase bid on the trading venue where the purchase is carried out. The shares are to be repurchased exclusively via the stock exchange in electronic trading on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (XETRA trading).

2. On any trading day, no more than 25 percent of the average daily volume of the shares on the trading venue on which the purchase is carried out is purchased (XETRA). The average daily trading volume is based on the average daily trading volume on this trading venue during the 20 trading days preceding the purchase date.

Information regarding transactions related to the share buyback programme will be disclosed in an appropriate, aggregated form no later than the end of the seventh trading day following the date of execution of the transactions. In addition, the Company will publish the disclosed transactions on its website under “Investor Relations – Share –Share Buybacks for Employee Participation” and ensure that the information remains publicly accessible for at least five years from the date of disclosure.

data.title: The DENSO GO (1950) Designated as a 2026 Japan Automotive Hall of Fame Historic & Heritage Vehicle
data.description:
KARIYA, JAPAN, Nov 22, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - DENSO CORPORATION announced that the DENSO GO , an electric vehicle developed by the company in 1950, has been designated as a 2026 Historic & Heritage Vehicle by the Japan Automotive Hall of Fame (JAHFA). The vehicle was officially honored on November 11, 2026. The Japan Automotive Hall of Fame recognizes individuals who have contributed to the development of Japan's automotive society, as well as automobiles of significant historical value, preserving their achievements for future generations.

The DENSO GO was developed in response to severe gasoline shortages in postwar Japan, with engineers turning their attention to alternative sources of energy. The development plan was launched in October 1949, shortly before the establishment of Nippondenso Co., Ltd., DENSO's predecessor. Less than nine months later, the vehicle underwent driving tests. In July 1950, 50 units were produced, all of which were sold.

The electric vehicle was powered by a DC motor developed in-house. Forty batteries were distributed between the front and rear of the vehicle, while the motor was positioned in the center to optimize weight balance. These and other innovations brought together the technologies and craftsmanship available at the time to overcome challenging road conditions and limited equipment and materials. The DENSO GO had a driving range of 195 kilometers on a single charge, a top speed of 43 km/h, and capacity for six occupants.

The DENSO GO embodies the spirit of DENSO's early years: looking ahead even in difficult times and bringing together technology and craftsmanship to address the challenges facing society. Building on the determination demonstrated by its predecessors in responding to postwar fuel shortages, DENSO has continued to take on the social challenges of each era.

The DENSO GO restored to commemorate DENSO's 60th anniversary is currently on display at the DENSO MUSEUM at the company's headquarters in Kariya, Aichi Prefecture. Through the DENSO GO and other exhibits, visitors can explore DENSO's history of taking on difficult challenges and using technology and craftsmanship to help shape the future.

DENSO will continue to contribute to a better future for mobility and society through its technology and craftsmanship.

DENSO MUSEUM

1-1 Showa-cho, Kariya, Aichi, Japan DENSO Headquarters, Building No. 5, 3rd Floor

Hours: 9:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Open on DENSO business days and the first Saturday of each month.

If the first Saturday falls during an extended company holiday, the museum will open on the second Saturday instead.

data.title: Bitcoin Price Recovered Above $60,000 – Will This Hold?
data.description:
After falling to a two-month low, Bitcoin’s price has rebounded above $61,000 on Sunday. Most options traders are betting for BTC to experience another deeper crash.

Analysts often treat that kind of crowded pessimism as a contrarian signal. So, the big question is, will this recovery hold for Bitcoin?

Crowded Shorts Got Caught on the Way Up

At the low, traders on Binance turned bearish. Its funding rate went negative, meaning short sellers paid a fee to hold their bets.

When the price bounced, those bets backfired

“This concentration of bearish sentiment can therefore provide an interesting contrarian signal, as much of the prevailing pessimism may already be priced in. Of course, this is by no means a foolproof reversal signal. Historically, some periods of negative funding rates have only led to short-lived rebounds,” a CryptoQuant analyst noted.

Short sellers took about 87% of the past day’s forced liquidations, CoinGlass data shows.

Retail Fear Eased, Though the Crowd Still Leans Bearish

Santiment’s bullish-to-bearish comment ratio for Bitcoin fell to 0.59, an Extreme Fear reading, as BTC broke below $60,000.

A reading below 1.0 means bearish posts outnumber bullish ones. The ratio has since recovered to about 0.77, leaving bears still in the majority.

Bitcoin sentiment turned bearish in early November too. BTC then climbed above $80,000 before sliding to lower lows within days.

Santiment has described extreme fear plus price stabilization as a stronger bottom signal than fear alone. One day of gains does not yet meet that second condition.

What Decides Whether the Bitcoin Price Rebound Holds?

Analyst Michaël van de Poppe is among the more hopeful voices. He said crashes this sharp have happened only 10 times in 9.5 years.

By his count, each one was followed by a 15% to 40% rebound within weeks.

“It doesn’t signal a bottom. It does signal a bounce,” he wrote.

On Sunday, he said a weekly close above $58,000 would make a relief rally more likely. Otherwise, he sees targets of $51,000 to $53,000 in play.

Maelstrom chief investment officer Arthur Hayes warned of lower Bitcoin price targets if tech stocks keep sliding.

“$BTC just decisively broke below the previous local low. If Nasdaq keeps puking, $50,000 will be the next real test,” Hayes stated.

A weekly close above $58,000 may offer the first sign of the stabilization Santiment wants to see.

data.title: WRD 3.0 Secures Ninth Championship Title, Making WeRide the China Urban Intelligent Driving Competition's Only Nine-Time Champion
data.description:
NANCHANG, China, Nov. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- At the Nanchang round of the China Urban Intelligent Driving Competition, the 2027 AION i60, equipped with WeRide’s WRD 3.0 one-stage end-to-end Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) solution, claimed the championship, delivering an outstanding performance with the only zero-takeover result across all competitors. This landmark victory made WeRide the competition’s first and only nine-time champion.

The achievement was further underscored in the preliminary round, where the GAC Trumpchi YUE7 and 2027 AION i60, both equipped with WRD 3.0, delivered the only two scores exceeding 100 points across all competitors, securing first and second place, respectively. The GAC Trumpchi Yue 7 went on to secure second place in its competition debut, marking the first time in the history of the China Intelligent Driving Competition that two mass-production vehicle models equipped with the same intelligent driving solution from a single provider have claimed both first and second place in a single station's final.

Final results at the China Urban Intelligent Driving Competition (Nanchang)

WeRide's nine championship titles are built on almost a decade of investment and technological expertise in Level 4 autonomous driving. Leveraging nearly 100 million kilometers of real-world testing and operational data, WeRide has integrated the perception, prediction, planning, and control capabilities validated through long-term Robotaxi operations into its WRD 3.0 one-stage end-to-end assisted driving solution.

The system continues to evolve through the combined capabilities of WeRide WITT, WeRide's Physical AI Cognitive Foundation Model, and WeRide GENESIS, WeRide's proprietary general-purpose simulation model. Together, they enhance the system's understanding of real-world traffic dynamics, complex interactions, and long-tail scenarios.

As of the end of Q3 2026, WeRide’s self-developed WRD 3.0 one-stage end-to-end solution had achieved over 100,000 cumulative deliveries, secured 10 additional mass-production design wins, and established mass-production partnerships with multiple automakers. From championship victories on the competition stage to large-scale commercial deployment, WeRide continues to demonstrate that its leading capabilities in the L2++/L3 segments can not only deliver competition-winning performance but also earn market recognition.

From technological innovation and product deployment to rapid iteration and large-scale commercialization, WeRide continues to advance the adoption of intelligent driving technologies. data.title: Hitachi Digital Launches HARC Compose to Turn Enterprise Intent into Trusted Outcomes at AI Speed
data.description:
SANTA CLARA, CA, Nov 22, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Hitachi Digital Inc.(*1) ("Hitachi Digital"), the global digital services company recently unveiled by Hitachi, Ltd. ("Hitachi"), launches HARC Compose, a unified product combining technology and services that helps enterprises consistently govern the lifecycle of agentic engineering across complex, AI-driven systems through enterprise specific context, guardrails and intent. Building on Hitachi's experience, HARC Compose helps companies orchestrate their execution of AI, from development to deployment through to operations and continuous improvement in a closed loop via standardized, failure-conscious engineering.

Hitachi Digital FDEs (forward deployed engineers) use HARC Compose to build trustworthy AI-native applications faster, and to continuously maintain and improve performance of AI agents once deployed. This strengthens Hitachi Digital's recurring service model, enabling its FDEs to provide customers with end-to-end support from ideas to outcomes, driving sustained value creation. With compatibility across multi-vendor environments, enterprises can leverage HARC Compose in its entirety or opt to use individual capabilities that suit their specific business goals.

HARC Compose strengthens HMAX by Hitachi, a next-generation suite of solutions bringing the power of AI to social infrastructure. The product augments HMAX Foundry solutions including HMAX Data Fabric, HMAX AI Operations, and HMAX Cyber.(*2) These collective capabilities provide end-to-end support, from developing secure AI agents that leverage enterprise knowledge and data to enabling stable, autonomous operations in secure environments, helping advance the real-world deployment of advanced AI.

(*1) Hitachi Digital is the unified brand of GlobalLogic, Inc. and Hitachi Digital Services LLC. The legal entity is scheduled to be established on April 1, 2027.

(*2) Press release issued on September 3, 2026: Hitachi Expands HMAX to Accelerate the Deployment of Physical AI

"HARC Compose is Hitachi Digital in action," said Anand Birje, CEO and Chairman, Hitachi Digital. "The true promise of AI isn't just writing code faster, it is shifting human ingenuity toward composing resilient, mission-critical systems. By bringing our engineering and operational expertise together, HARC Compose allows clients to innovate at AI speed while running what they build with proven reliability. Eliminating the divide between build and run closes the feedback loop, delivering the governance and trust that the world's most demanding enterprises require."

AI has made code development significantly faster and more productive. But that does not mean it is trustworthy when running across enterprise systems. Without the right context-enterprise knowledge, company goals, policies, systems, and risk requirements-fast code becomes fast failure. From planning through production, HARC Compose carries enterprise intent as it orchestrates AI agents across the build, deploy and operate agentic engineering process. All while keeping human experts in control of critical decisions.

"In an era of AI-generated software, speed is expected-trust has to be earned," said Premkumar Balasubramanian, Chief Technology Officer, Hitachi Digital. "Customers need clarity on what a software change is meant to improve, proof that it worked, and confidence in the process behind it. With HARC Compose, we're making AI-native engineering faster, more consistent, and fundamentally accountable. Our forward deployed engineers direct AI agents to build, test, and coordinate changes, while maintaining strict human oversight over what goes live. By using live production evidence to verify outcomes, we give customers true peace of mind for the software their businesses run on."

Built for Trust in Production

HARC Compose helps enterprises standardize and govern how they build, deploy, and run software. Engineering and operations teams work from shared business goals, applying enterprise policies at each stage. These goals and policies guide what teams build, how they use AI agents, when they release changes, and how they judge success in production. HARC Compose then enables Hitachi Digital's global FDEs to rapidly drive continuous improvement and reduce risks across AI-driven enterprises.

Alongside its core Build, Deploy, and Operate capabilities, HARC Compose includes the following:

- CAKE (Context-Aware Knowledge Engine): connects enterprise intent, domain knowledge, systems, policies, risks, security, decision and production history. Gives AI agents that information to enable reliable, responsible output. Also flags gaps and contradictions before agents act, so new work isn't built on guesswork or unresolved production issues.

- Orchestration Engine: coordinates multiple agents across the build, deploy and operate processes as one system. Grounded in enterprise-specific context and guardrails, the engine supports various AI agents and tools selected by customers, enabling them to be flexibly combined and utilized even within a multi-vendor environment. This allows enterprises to augment the value and productivity of their current systems without having to replace their existing coding tools, AI harnesses, or development and operations environments.

- Failure-conscious Engineering: teams use failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to identify how a proposed change could fail and to decide what to test before release. Translates those risks into tests, controls, and recovery strategies.

Spanning the above are universal product capabilities adding still more oversight. Responsible AI guards against system deviations such as agent drift. Meanwhile, guided and autonomous work maintain human engagement. Engineers review decisions prior to agent action in guided work whereas agents proceed within agreed limits as engineers monitor them in autonomous work.

Via Hitachi-driven system integration and extensible interfaces, HARC Compose is designed to work within existing enterprise technology environments-supporting preferred software delivery, operational, governance and business intelligence systems.

Outcome-Forward Engineering Connects Intent to Outcomes

HARC Compose is built on OFE (outcome-forward engineering), a methodology used by Hitachi Digital's own FDE teams. Outcome-forward engineering treats Define, Build, Deploy and Operate processes as one continuous system. Further, delivery is considered complete only when a system yields the intended business outcomes in the real world; not at system release.

This is made possible by OFE's defining principles:

- Fidelity: establishes intent, constraints, failure risks and guardrails before work begins- Throughput: uses coding agents to rapidly turn clear intent into operable change

- Trust: validates intended outcome is achieved and sustainable in production

The above three principles are connected by CAKE, with the engine giving AI agents access to relevant enterprise knowledge including earlier engineering decisions.

Available to enterprises worldwide, HARC Compose deployments supported by Hitachi Digital FDEs are already underway in the finance, healthcare, and technology industries. The product's capabilities are expected to expand as Hitachi Digital grows its technical talent base and ecosystem alliances.

data.title: Delta Delays Hundreds of Flights Over System Outage — WSJ
data.description:
By Alison Sider

Hundreds of Delta Air Lines flights were delayed Sunday as the airline tried to resolve a problem with the system that calculates the weight and balance of its planes.

Delta said it was trying to restore the automation that tabulates the calculations required for planes to take off. In the meantime, it was using manual workarounds to allow flights to depart safely and was working with air-traffic control to prevent the slowdown from clogging up its Atlanta hub.

"We thank our customers for their patience and our people for their professionalism," the airline said in a statement.

Many Americans are already on edge following a string of technology outages affecting everything from email access and banking services to travel.

Just over a week ago, a nationwide ground stop halted departures for more than four hours and resulted in cancellations throughout the weekend. Federal officials have blamed that outage on a newly installed router that appeared to have begun spewing out data that swamped the network, leading to interference with communications between pilots and air-traffic controllers around the U.S. United Airlines last week also had a brief technology system outage.

Delta's issue comes at the beginning of the busy Thanksgiving travel season.

More than 1,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday, about a third of its mainline schedule, according to FlightAware.

Departure delays from the airline's Atlanta hub increased throughout the morning, but by about 10 a.m., Delta's flights were again departing Atlanta on time, according to Cirium, another aviation analytics company.

It isn't clear what is causing the issue. The airline told employees in a message viewed by The Wall Street Journal that its IT teams were working to resolve a "database issue" that was affecting the system that tracks aircraft-loading information used to calculate its final weight with passengers, fuel and bags.

It cautioned that the manual workaround "drives high call volume and workload" that increases with the number of planned departures.

Delta didn't immediately respond to a request for comment on that message.

data.title: JPMorgan estimates Bitcoin mining costs at $86K as price sinks far below
data.description:
Mining a single Bitcoin now costs an estimated $86,000, according to JPMorgan. The market currently values that same coin at roughly $25,000 less.

The estimate comes from a report dated November 18, 2026. The JPMorgan analyst team behind it is led by Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou. They put the average production cost of Bitcoin at approximately $86,000.

That figure has been rising all year. In June 2026, the bank pegged production costs in a range of $77,000 to $78,000. By September, the estimate had moved up to $85,000.

Meanwhile, the price went the other way. Bitcoin was trading near $65,000 when the report came out. That left miners facing a shortfall of around $21,000 on every coin they produced.

Two days later, things got worse. On November 20, Bitcoin slipped below $60,000. That pushed the gap between production cost and market price beyond $26,000.

JPMorgan describes production cost as a "soft floor" rather than a strict support level.

Production cost serves as a "soft floor" rather than a strict support level for price valuation.

The analysts expect higher-cost miners to respond in a few ways. Some are likely to sell more of their Bitcoin reserves to cover operating expenses. Others may pivot toward artificial intelligence infrastructure, redirecting their power and hardware to a different line of business.

JPMorgan suggests the gap could narrow even if Bitcoin's price doesn't recover. As unprofitable miners shut down, hashrate falls. According to the analysts, that drop could trigger a downward adjustment in difficulty. Lower difficulty means the remaining miners need less computing effort per coin, pulling the average production cost down.

The report ties recent price weakness to broader forces. One factor is retail-driven outflows from Bitcoin and ether exchange-traded funds. The other factor is shifting expectations around interest rate cuts.

If higher-cost miners sell reserves to stay afloat, that adds coins to an already soft market. Extra selling pressure could weigh on prices further, especially without a matching rise in demand.

For investors, a few signals stand out. Hashrate is the clearest one. A sustained decline would suggest unprofitable miners are capitulating, which JPMorgan's framework treats as the path toward cost relief. Difficulty adjustments are the second signal. A meaningful downward revision would indicate the network is recalibrating to a smaller miner base. ETF flows are the third. Since JPMorgan links recent weakness to retail outflows from those funds, a reversal there would address the demand side of the equation directly.

data.title: Trump Rewards Top Owners of His Declining Coin With Exclusive Dinner — WSJ
data.description:
By Neil Mehta, Vicky Ge Huang and Natalie Andrews

President Trump will reward top owners of his declining meme coin with an exclusive dinner Sunday near Washington featuring himself and a number of celebrities, including Kevin O'Leary, the entrepreneur best known for his role on "Shark Tank."

A similar dinner in May 2025 was sought after by crypto moguls and others seeking an audience with Trump, with would-be guests competing for 220 open seats. But since that gathering, the coin's value has plummeted by around 90%, and the event is struggling to fill 185 seats despite it being cheaper to buy the meme coin.

Other advertised guests at the dinner, slated for Trump's golf club outside Washington in Sterling, Va., include boxer Floyd Mayweather, former NBA player Tristan Thompson and mentalist Lior Suchard.

The $TRUMP cryptocurrency briefly commanded a paper valuation exceeding $14 billion in January 2025, around the president's second inauguration. Its per-coin peak was around $74. It now trades below $1, leaving hundreds of thousands of small investors with steep losses while Trump-affiliated entities collected hundreds of millions of dollars in fees and token sales.

Trump himself made $635 million in meme-coin royalties last year, part of a $1.4 billion windfall in crypto income in 2025.

At the dinner, the top 29 holders of his coin will also get access to a VIP reception with Trump. The top four will get 18-karat gold Trump watches, provided they hold at least one million Trump coins — worth roughly $850,000. The dinner's website says guests won't be able to privately meet with the president.

Among those who will attend the VIP reception is Morten Christensen, the founder of crypto firm AirdropAlert.com. The $TRUMP investor found a way to qualify for the event's VIP leaderboard while hedging his financial risk.

Christensen said he bought 75,000 $TRUMP tokens at an average price of $1.70 per token to secure his spot, while simultaneously betting against a roughly equal amount using perpetual futures on the decentralized exchange Hyperliquid. (Perpetual futures allow traders to bet on an asset's price movements without owning it, with the majority side paying fees to the minority side.) Thanks to those fee payouts, Christensen calculated that his plan to attend the dinner netted him a $6 profit. He said he paid roughly $1,200 to qualify for the May 2025 dinner.

The Sunday dinner would mark Christensen's third $TRUMP memecoin-affiliated event, and he used the same trading strategy to help his sister qualify to attend the dinner as well. Even though crypto assets have struggled over the past year, he said he was still looking forward to having a good time.

"I think the vibe will be a lot different," he said. "But it's always a unique experience to be in a room with the president."

Justin Sun, a crypto billionaire who was the largest holder of $TRUMP at last year's dinner, isn't attending this year's event, a person familiar with the matter said. He has since sued Trump's crypto company, World Liberty Financial, accusing it of freezing valuable digital tokens because he refused to invest more money with the company. World Liberty has called Sun's claims "entirely meritless."

The dinner follows stunning losses for the GOP in the midterm elections, which awarded the Democrats majorities in both chambers of Congress come January. Top Democrats are preparing for investigations into Trump's business dealings, including his crypto-related ventures.

Trump advertised the meme coin as his own in a January 2025 X post. "My NEW Official Trump Meme is HERE!" he wrote. "Join my very special Trump Community. GET YOUR $TRUMP NOW."

The White House didn't respond to a request for comment. Trump has previously said he knows little about the coin besides launching it.

In addition to Trump's namesake coin, first lady Melania Trump promoted $MELANIA, which peaked early at a value past $8 but now trades at around 4 cents.

The crypto landscape has shifted dramatically since Trump's inaugural meme-coin dinner. Bitcoin, the largest cryptocurrency, recently dropped below $60,000, more than 50% off the peak above $126,000 it reached in October 2025.

The industry also suffered a legislative setback in September when the Clarity Act failed to advance in the Senate. The bill, backed by the crypto industry, meant to usher digital assets into the mainstream financial system. Meanwhile, surging interest in artificial intelligence and prediction markets has drawn away the retail traders who once fueled the crypto frenzy.

Write to Neil Mehta at neil.mehta@wsj.com, Vicky Ge Huang at vicky.huang@wsj.com and Natalie Andrews at natalie.andrews@wsj.com

data.title: U.N. Climate Talks Collapse Over Fossil Fuel Rift — WSJ
data.description:
By Matthew Dalton

United Nations climate talks collapsed on Sunday after Europe and some nations that want more ambitious policies to limit global warming refused to accept a deal that didn't call for economies to move away from burning fossil fuels.

Negotiators met in Antalya on Turkey's Mediterranean coast for the past two weeks at the U.N.'s annual climate change meeting to forge a new global consensus on the response to global warming. This year, however, they were facing an energy shock from the Iran war that left much of the world reeling from higher prices. That made developing countries more reluctant to back a deal that would limit investment in new supplies of oil, natural gas and coal, analysts said.

"It is unconscionable that we would have a climate act that makes no reference to fossil fuel, no reference to transitioning away from fossil fuel either," said Darragh O'Brien, climate minister of Ireland, which holds the European Union's rotating presidency.

Excluding mention of fossil fuels would have reversed a deal struck at climate talks three years ago in Dubai that calls for "transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems, in a just, orderly and equitable manner." That marked the first time U.N. nations agreed to shift away from fossil fuels, a significant concession from fossil-fuel producers and large developing economies such as India and South Africa that still rely heavily on coal to power their economies.

The talks in Turkey were also hamstrung by gridlock over setting a global target for wealthy nations to provide funds for the developing world to adapt to the effects of climate change. Wealthy nations have long struggled to live up to commitments they made to finance the developing world's response to climate change. The Trump administration's decision to withdraw from the Paris accord, the landmark climate deal signed in 2015, and end all climate finance has left a big hole in the developed world's commitments.

This month's talks come as global temperatures have come close to breaching the limits of the Paris accord, which calls for governments to limit warming to "well under" two degrees Celsius compared with the preindustrial era and strive to keep it at 1.5 degrees. The World Meteorological Organization said this month that temperatures between January and September were 1.47 degrees Celsius over the preindustrial era, and scientists say breaching 1.5 degrees in the coming decades is inevitable.

At the same time, the economies are investing in wind and solar energy at a breakneck pace, a shift that analysts say has been accelerated by the Iran-war price shock. Global carbon-dioxide emissions are likely to fall this year, scientists say, as economies consume less oil and lean more on renewable energy sources.

"We're in the midst of a major transition in the global energy landscape," said David Waskow of The World Resources Institute, "and the dynamic at COP31 reflected the tensions over that transition."

Write to Matthew Dalton at Matthew.Dalton@wsj.com

data.title: Iowa detonation of lead will proceed under emergency powers, Army says, bypassing court order
data.description:
By Jack Queen

The US Army will detonate 68 barrels of toxic lead azide in Iowa by Tuesday under emergency legal powers that allow it to bypass a court order blocking the controversial plan, the Trump administration told a court this weekend.

“The Army must perform a controlled detonation to protect the public from the more significant threat from an uncontrolled explosion, and the Army intends to act by November 24, 2026,” the Justice Department said in a court filing late on Saturday.

The US Court of Appeals for the 8th Circuit temporarily halted the detonation by freezing the Army’s environmental permit on Thursday after environmental groups sued to halt the operation. The government said in Saturday night's filing that the Army plans to move forward without a permit by invoking an emergency munitions and explosives exception to federal environmental protection laws.

Federal officials say the detonation must go forward within the next several days because a drop in temperatures could destabilize the material and cause an uncontrolled explosion.

The Army previously postponed plans to detonate the degraded lead azide, an explosive used in military munitions, after public outcry by residents and farmers near Middletown, Iowa.

The Army did not immediately respond to an inquiry on Sunday about the precise timing of the detonation.

The Iowa Environmental Council and the Sierra Club's Iowa chapter filed the lawsuit. Earthjustice, a nonprofit environmental law organization suing on behalf ​of the groups, did not immediately respond to an email on Sunday seeking comment.

The plaintiffs have argued that the detonations would release a toxic plume of lead dust ​into the air that could travel 100 miles (161 kilometers) north of the site, depending on weather conditions.

In a statement on Thursday, acting Secretary of the Army Adam Telle said the Army had determined with the US Environmental Protection Agency that a controlled detonation to dispose of the degraded lead was the option that posed the lowest risk to the public.

Lead exposure can cause serious health problems, particularly in children, including ​damage to the brain ​and nervous system.

The Army has advised people to avoid the affected area during the detonation and urged anyone who could not leave beforehand to stay indoors, close windows and doors and shut off heating and cooling systems. Residents should wet-clean surfaces children may touch to remove any lead dust once the exposure period has ended, the Army said.

The Iowa Department of Agriculture and Land Stewardship has recommended that cattle farmers near the detonation site move their livestock, feed and equipment to alternate ​locations or indoors.

data.title: Delta flights delayed due to automated system issue
data.description:
Delta Air Lines flights traveling to and from Atlanta have been delayed following a problem with the system that calculates a plane’s weight and balance, the FAA said, according to multiple reports.

According to an FAA advisory, flights have been delayed for about an hour. The delay affects all Delta flights departing to Atlanta from within the contiguous United States, as well as flights leaving Atlanta. Delta is the only commercial airline currently subject to the delay program.

The issue centers on the system that calculates the total weight of an airplane—including its airframe, fuel, passengers, and baggage. This system also helps pilots determine the plane’s center of gravity and proper weight distribution—key data points for flight safety.

In a statement on Sunday, Delta said its teams are using manual workarounds to safely depart flights while efforts continue to restore automation. The airline also noted it is coordinating with air traffic controllers to help reduce congestion at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, Delta’s largest hub.

data.title: MHI and SAKURA internet to form Strategic Alliance to Build Japan's Sovereign AI Infrastructure
data.description:
Tokyo and Osaka, Nov 22, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. (President and CEO: Eisaku Ito; Head Office: Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo; "MHI") and SAKURA internet Inc. (Founder, CEO, and President: Kunihiro Tanaka; Head Office: Osaka City, Osaka; "SAKURA internet") today announced that they have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to form a strategic alliance. Under the MOU, the two companies will explore collaboration to strengthen Japan's domestic digital infrastructure for the sovereign AI and cloud(1) era. The initiative includes developing AI modular data centers that can be built efficiently and rapidly.

Growing Importance of Digital Sovereignty and Infrastructure Resiliency in the AI Era

The rapid spread of generative AI has made data centers essential infrastructure for government and industry. At the same time, much of the AI processing in Japan runs on cloud platforms operated overseas, which leaves it exposed to sudden service changes or suspensions. As a result, securing digital sovereignty and resilience (the ability to recover quickly from unforeseen events) for AI infrastructure designed, built, and operated in Japan is becoming a key challenge.

Securing sovereignty also requires stronger physical infrastructure. AI data centers need large-scale power and advanced cooling, and the time it takes to secure power and complete construction can delay the start of operations.

AI infrastructure must also remain resilient to disasters and geopolitical uncertainty, making the rapid and reliable development of data centers a strategic priority.

Two Strengths, One Objective

MHI has a long track record of supplying and operating resilient, safe, and secure equipment and systems across social infrastructure, aviation, defense, space, and other fields. It has technology and know-how in design, manufacturing, control, simulation and maintenance, data grounded in real-world site conditions, and the trust of customers across these industries. MHI has made resilience one of the pillars of its growth strategy, meaning keeping social infrastructure running and enabling rapid recovery in an increasingly uncertain environment. As part of this, it is strengthening its data center business, which integrates cooling, power, control and high-security technologies.

SAKURA internet was selected by Japan's Digital Agency as a Government Cloud service provider for fiscal year 2026, the first domestic cloud provider to be selected. It operates data centers in Tokyo, Osaka and Hokkaido and has an extensive track record in building and operating data centers and cloud services.

Combining these strengths, the two companies will explore collaboration in two areas:

1. Domestic digital infrastructure: jointly building a secure, high-performance, Japan-based digital infrastructure foundation for the sovereign AI and sovereign cloud era and offering vertically integrated services.

2. AI modular data centers: building highly efficient AI data centers quickly for next-generation AI infrastructure, including exploring reference architectures and modular construction methods for mechanical and electrical equipment.

"As AI becomes national infrastructure, that infrastructure has to be resilient in both how it is built and how it is operated. With SAKURA internet, we want to give Japan a sovereign AI foundation that is secure, available when it matters, and fast enough to keep pace with demand. This is part of MHI ITO(2) initiative: combining our strengths with the right partner to deliver value to far more customers." - Masayuki Suematsu, Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd.

"With the rapid spread of AI, digital infrastructure such as cloud and data centers has become essential to society and industry. In this collaboration, we will combine MHI's technology and expertise in social infrastructure with our own experience building and operating cloud and data centers. Together, we aim to create new options for the domestic digital infrastructure that the sovereign AI and sovereign cloud era requires." - Kunihiro Tanaka, Founder, Chief Executive Officer, and President, SAKURA internet Inc.

Looking ahead, the two companies aim to take the products and solutions established through this collaboration to global markets, including Asia and Oceania.

(1) Sovereign AI / cloud: An approach that allows data and AI platforms to be operated and used under a country's own laws and control.

(2) "Innovative Total Optimization" MHI's management methodology, built on the pillars of "total optimization" and "domain expansion".

About Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Group

Since its foundation in 1884, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group has grown into a global leader in engineering and manufacturing, consistently addressing societal challenges and supporting people's lives. By integrating cutting-edge knowledge with the advanced technological capabilities developed over our long history, we will continue to tackle social issues and contribute to the realization of a safe and prosperous society. For more information, please visit www.mhi.com or follow our insights and stories on spectra.mhi.com.

About SAKURA internet Inc.

SAKURA internet is a digital infrastructure company founded in 1996. It provides highly reliable cloud and computing platforms as "SAKURA Cloud," "SAKURA Web Hosting," and "SAKURA VPS" from its self-operated domestic data centers. Under the corporate philosophy of "Turning 'what you want to do' into 'what you can do,' " we develop a variety of services to meet customer needs and propose DX solutions that cater to various industries. For more information, please visit https://www.sakura.ad.jp/corporate/en/.
